rows.prompt: RimWorld animal sprite, full body, adult bull BANTHA (Star Wars, Tatooine), side view facing right for east. A massive, heavyset, shaggy quadruped the size of a bison or larger, covered head to hooves in long, hanging, dark chocolate-brown to near-black hair that falls in heavy curtains over the legs. A pair of large, pale ivory ram horns curl in tight full spirals beside the head. THE FACE IS THE PRIORITY: a broad, flat, ape-like face with a wide flat nose and a VERY WIDE, FLAT, SLIT-LIKE MOUTH stretching almost the full width of the muzzle, a long straight horizontal line under the nose, clearly legible at sprite size; small deep-set dark eyes under a heavy brow. A long beard-like fringe of hair hangs from the chin and chest. Heavy, slow, grounded stance on four thick legs. Painted to match the canon reference look of the infobox photo: shaggy fur texture, warm chestnut highlights on the face, cream horns contrasting the dark coat.
rows.style_notes: Owner redo 2026-10-04 (doubles sheet, BanthaW): 'Look at the canon library and regen to modern standards. Criteria: it MUST have that very wide-slit mouth as shown in the canon imagery.' Ships into a CutoutComplex slot tinted (67,38,32) - reviewer judges the untinted render first.

rows.prompt: RimWorld animal sprite, full body, FEMALE BANTHA COW (Star Wars, Tatooine), side view facing right for east - the same species and painted look as the bull: a heavyset, shaggy quadruped covered in long, hanging, dark chocolate-brown to near-black hair. She differs from the bull in two ways only: her horns are SHORT - a pale ivory pair that curls only a half turn close against the side of the head, well under half the bull's horn size - and her frame is a little lighter. Four thick legs, grounded stance.
rows.style_notes: Owner redo 2026-10-04 (doubles sheet, BanthaW_j): 'Female short-horn version of above' - pairs with doubles_redo_bantha_w_v1. rows.prompt: RimWorld animal sprite, full body, an adult DALGO (Star Wars, Onderon), side view facing right for east, unsaddled. A tall reptilian runner with a raptor-like build: a deep chest, a long muscular neck carried upright, and long thin legs built for sprinting, standing high off the ground. A tall fan-shaped sail crest of ridged skin runs from the crown of the head down the back of the neck. A long snout with a row of sharp teeth and two lower tusks curving up from the jaw. Hide is warm rust-orange with darker rust banding along the back and crest and a pale cream-tan throat, underside and belly. A long tail ending in a wide, flat, blade-like tip. Rendered as a high-quality painted natural-history illustration matching the canon Encyclopedia and Secrets of Tatooine artwork.
rows.style_notes: Owner redo 2026-10-04 (doubles sheet, Dalgo): 'Canon shows somthing more like C. We need a high quality version of that. Look at Canon please.' C was a cartoon-register sail-crested orange dalgo (pyrelands_dalgo_v1); kept from C: the sail crest, tusked snout, rust-orange over cream palette. Reference of record per the 2026-09-14 ruling: canon_references/dalgo/wookieepedia_sot_art.png (long-legged build). Fresh render, not an edit of C: C is a flat cartoon register on a low body, both against current art law and canon.

rows.prompt: RimWorld animal sprite, full body, an adult EOPIE (Star Wars, Tatooine) pack animal, side view facing right for east. Smooth, leathery, hairless skin in pale cream to dusty pinkish-grey, never brown, with soft wrinkles at the joints and neck. A long, low, camel-like barrel body carried high on four long, thin, knobbly legs ending in small splayed clawed toes. A long neck held forward and low, ending in a head drawn out into a long drooping trunk-like snout like a tapir's, with one large dark eye set well back on the head. Bare back, no saddle or cargo. Painted to match the canon film-model look: wrinkled pale hide, believable weight on thin legs.
rows.style_notes: Owner redo 2026-10-04 (doubles sheet, Eopie): 'B is closest but still pretty bad. Please look at Canon imagery.' The EopieA-E alternates and Eopie_j were marked 'redundant with above'. Hairless: the shipped B art drew shaggy fur, which canon does not show.

rows.prompt: RimWorld animal sprite, full body, an EOPIE CALF (Star Wars, Tatooine), side view facing right for east - the young of the adult eopie: smooth, leathery, hairless pale cream to dusty pinkish-grey skin, never brown; a shorter barrel body on long, thin, gangly knobbly legs with small clawed toes; a shorter neck and a shorter trunk-like snout than the adult; one large dark eye set back on the head; proportions of a young foal, leggy and slightly awkward.
